description: This PHP source file defines a class FunctionalTestingPluginSubscriber within the OrangeHRM framework. It subscribes to kernel controller events to enforce access restrictions to the '/functional-testing' path when in production mode, throwing a ForbiddenException if access is attempted. The class relies on traits and other framework components to determine the context and enforce certain rules related to functional testing paths.

classes.name: FunctionalTestingPluginSubscriber
classes.description: A class that subscribes to Symfony kernel controller events to restrict access to functional testing endpoints in production mode, enhancing security during deployment.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events this subscriber is listening to, specifically the kernel controller event.

methods.name: onControllerEvent
methods.description: Handles the controller event; checks if the request path is under '/functional-testing' and throws a ForbiddenException if in production mode.

methods.name: getControllerInstance
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve the controller object from the event.
